column1: # Fairservis 1992, The Harappan Civilization and its Writing, Appendix A; archive.org identifier fairservis-the-harappan-civilization-and-its-writing-1992 (leaves n158-n197; also the-harappan-civilization-and-its-writing)
# language: dra. Read from the page images of the Appendix A tables (Sign No. / Identification / Dravidian Equivalent / DED No. / Homophone / DED No. / Meaning).
# value = Dravidian equivalent as printed (alternatives separated by ' / '; 'hom:' = the homophone column). dedr = Fairservis's DED/DEDR numbers (first = equivalent, after ';' = homophone).

# gloss = his identification of the drawing, then '=>' his meaning. icit = ICIT glyph id matched by drawing against the ICIT render sheets; confidence sure/likely/unsure; unsure rows give candidates as a|b.

# page = printed page number (archive.org leaf in brackets). Fairservis cites seals by Marshall 1931 / Mackay 1937 (MD) numbers, not CISI numbers, so seal confirmation through corpus.tsv was not possible.
